Retry policy

The client retries a failed request with a growing delay. The first retry waits one second. Each later retry waits twice as long as the retry before it, up to a limit of thirty seconds.

Only server errors and timeouts are retried. A client error such as 400 or 404 is returned to the caller at once, because a second attempt sends the same bad request again.

Limits

The retry count is set when the client is created. The default is three attempts after the first request. Set the count to zero to turn retries off.
